dedupe_keys.name: bev energy dynamics in charging driving and parking

description: KU Leuven publishes one-second battery-electric-vehicle energy measurements across charging, driving and parking sessions. The repository abstract identifies charger, battery and auxiliary-device signals; the describing article reports about 2,310 session files and includes a DBC file, preprocessing examples and a README in the deposit. DataCite lists CC BY 4.0 and open access at no cost. These traces can calibrate vehicle-level energy-use and charging behaviour in transport-grid simulations, with data-urbanev-shenzhen-ev-charging offering a separate observed-demand benchmark. Coverage is the sampled vehicle fleet and its recorded sessions. A caveat is that one sampled fleet and operating protocol do not represent all vehicle classes, trips or chargers. Session labels, signal units and timestamp synchronization require checking before merging files. Own registry metadata and the repository address were verified without downloading observations. Companion processing examples are covered within this same deposit, not counted as independent software.
